اخشوشبوا (form XII)
# اِخْشَوْشَبُوا (iḵšawšabū) /ix.ʃaw.ʃa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْشَوْشَبَ (iḵšawšaba)
# اِخْشَوْشِبُوا (iḵšawšibū) /ix.ʃaw.ʃi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْشَوْشَبَ (iḵšawšaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
